title: Keto Algerian Tagine
description: A keto twist on a traditional North African dish, featuring acrid spices and tender tofu. Perfect for a low-carb dinner.
instructions: 2. Cut the tofu into 1-inch cubes and place on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
3. Drizzle the olive oil over the tofu and sprinkle with Algerian spice blend, acrid spices, and garlic. Toss to coat.
4. Roast the tofu in the preheated oven for 20-25 minutes, or until golden brown and crispy.
5. While the tofu is roasting, chop the fresh parsley and set aside.
6. Once the tofu is done, remove from the oven and sprinkle with salt to taste.
7. Garnish with chopped parsley and serve hot.
